scope: Opt-in complete configured inventory lexical-category contracts; no default English activation and no semantic/productivity/human efficacy claim.
baseline: Reuse only authenticated Q11b composed-control archives with the identical 2-policy, 4-profile, 5-development-seed, 10000-per-stream protocol and exact source/configuration identity. Otherwise capture same registered population. Baseline has no observed stem categories; do not label its emitted words category violations.
treatment: Template sampled using existing weights; joint licensed stem/sense path sampled from stem weight times configured affix frequencies divided across senses. Forced short both plans project to suffix-only paths before selection, excluding incompatible projections. No silent fallback on empty pools.
seeds: Reuse exact committed Q02 stream coordinates and Q11b baseline measurement protocol; no held-out tuning.
primary: Zero category transition violations in every retained candidate morphology trace
Independent enumeration agrees on all path identities and weights; each sense and positive-weight compatible path remains eligible
Observed root/sense/final-category/template distributions with eligibility denominators and requested/retained-template distinctions
secondary: Full phoneme, spelling, stress, root-length, RNG and morphology source/provenance comparisons
Seed-stream diversity and common evaluator metrics; all strata retained even if worsened
Trace/plain parity and disabled-policy full word/trace plus next-RNG probes
Existing unchanged full, quality and performance gates; no assertion/sample/timeout/heap changes
Interleaved same-sample performance with all runs retained
sourceSemantics: Stem categories and equal priors/sense shares are authored assumptions. Statistical category legality is not proof of semantic or inflectional well-formedness.
structuralGuard: Retained suffix-only path must be recomputed from the original stem when a prefix is dropped; do not report stale planned output categories.
